signature.name: VTask.blimsup
signature.type: {α : Type u_1} -> {β : Type u_2} -> [ConditionallyCompleteLattice α] -> (u : β → α) -> (f : Filter β) -> (p : β → Prop) -> α

conventions.note: When the predicate is identically False, the implication 'p x → u x ≤ a' holds vacuously for every a, so the infimum over all a is the bottom element ⊥.

conventions.statement: VTask.blimsup u f (fun _ => True) = Filter.limsup u f
conventions.note: When the predicate is identically True, the bounded limsup degenerates to the ordinary (unbounded) limsup along f.

facts.statement: ∀ {α : Type*} {β : Type*} [ConditionallyCompleteLattice α] (u : β → α) (f : Filter β), VTask.blimsup u f (fun _ => True) = Filter.limsup u f

facts.statement: ∀ {α : Type*} {β : Type*} [ConditionallyCompleteLattice α] (u : β → α) (f : Filter β) (p q : β → Prop), (∀ x, p x → q x) → VTask.blimsup u f p ≤ VTask.blimsup u f q
